engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.actualTurn: The owning player's current actual turn number and turn-owner seat identify the history. Extra actual turns start a fresh predecessor chain; additional phases within the same actual turn share it.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.actualUse: Native CardActionType.Use plus the engine's native own Dodge-Use and Nullification-Use response contracts count. Pure Duel Slash, group Dodge and faction supply are responses and do not create predecessors. Other players' uses and out-of-turn owner uses do not enter this own-turn chain.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.predecessor: At the actual CardUseCommitted boundary before candidate collection, freeze the exact previous recorded actual-use identity for the same actual turn and actor. This includes native Slash before its later Accepted event; nested uses cannot rewrite the relation.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.appearance: Use the engine's already-frozen EffectiveIsRed at actual payment/acceptance, including effective conversion appearance and homogeneous multi-material colors. Do not reread later hand or equipment state.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.colorless: Nullable color is the engine's no-color value: colorless versus red or black differs; two colorless uses match. The selected official page does not provide a separate colorless FAQ.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.privacy: Trusted internal IsRed state is JsonIgnore and internal on the scalar history fact; public event properties and ToString expose only use identities and actual-turn boundaries. Hidden declaration material is not replaced by an invented colorless value. Command replay reconstructs the trusted internal state.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.drawReturn: The new operation grants one exact use-pair/source-instance entitlement. Its following ordinary Draw instruction owns physical movement and existing CardsGained children, avoiding a parallel pending object or another use-ID store.
